verdict.line: You lose if he lands a second Ntofo Strikes stack and shockwave-pulls you into his stun; you win every exchange you fight outside 600 range and his 250-range All Out.

brief.thesis: This matchup is a range check: Jayce's Cannon-stance Shock Blast and Acceleration Gate combo let him poke safely from well outside K'Sante's Ntofo Strikes and his 250-range All Out knockback, but the moment K'Sante lands a second Q stack the shockwave pulls Jayce into point-blank range where K'Sante's shield and stun win the fight. That single pull is why the data reads even on lane shape but gives K'Sante the solo-kill edge.

theirWindow.when: he already has one Q stack on you
theirWindow.what: Disengage immediately. The second Ntofo Strikes hit fires a shockwave that pulls you into melee range, right where his W (Path Maker) stun and E (Footwork) shield start winning the fight.

yourWindow.when: his E (Footwork) is on visible cooldown
yourWindow.what: He has no dash to close distance for 10/9.5/9/8.5/8s. Walk up and freely land Cannon-stance Q or autoattacks, and fire Shock Blast through your own Acceleration Gate for the boosted missile speed, range, and damage.

runes.keystoneWhy: 53.3% WR over a 13.8%-pick sample — fits the measured defensive shape of this matchup, sustaining you through his Q poke and stack attempts. Master-tier Jayce players instead run Stormraider's Surge (Sorcery) across 3,527 games; that suits players who stance-swap aggressively and want the extra move speed to kite rather than trade through tank stats.

summoners.why: Flash+Ignite measures 55% WR (25.3% pick) versus Flash+Teleport's 50.2% — Ignite punishes his Footwork shield healing and closes out the kill windows this matchup's data says K'Sante otherwise wins.

playing.title: Poke only from Cannon stance
playing.detail: Stay in Cannon form and fire Shock Blast through your own Acceleration Gate (E) for the boosted missile speed, range, and damage — this is your main damage source all lane.

playing.title: Reset his Q stacks
playing.detail: Never let him land a second Ntofo Strikes hit. Back off after one hit on your minions or you so the shockwave pull never triggers.

playing.title: Deny his ult range
playing.detail: All Out has only 250 range. If you poke from outside that threshold he physically cannot use it on you without first closing distance with Q, W, or E.

playing.title: Punish his Footwork cooldown
playing.detail: E (Footwork) is 10/9.5/9/8.5/8s. The moment he dashes in or out, step up and land free Cannon Q or autoattacks before it's back.

playing.title: Respect the W charge-up
playing.detail: Path Maker telegraphs a charge-up (reduced damage taken) before the knockback/stun dash. Disengage the instant you see the charge animation.

playing.title: Swap to Hammer to peel
playing.detail: If he closes with W's dash or All Out's knockback, use R to swap and land E (Thundering Blow) to knock him back off you — the form-swap's first hit also deals bonus magic damage.

playing.title: All-in during his All Out window
playing.detail: All Out (120/100/80/80/80s cooldown) raises his damage and healing but lowers his defenses. Swap to Hammer and burst him in that window rather than trying to kite it out.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners, and all win-rate/sample numbers above are measured from live games on the current patch (16.20.1); the mechanical reasoning and trade-pattern advice are my own analysis.
